runtime.name: python-task-container
runtime.description: Python 3.12 standard library in a fresh non-root, network-disabled container. The root filesystem is read-only. Files under /inputs are root-owned and read-only to the agent. /work is writable. No host files or credentials.

tools.execute_python: Execute Python to inspect files, make targeted edits, and run local checks inside this container. It cannot change input-file ownership or write protected files. Each call has a 20-second limit.

scope: One public notebook workflow, unchanged public template and previously used public catalog; ten paired trials, not full-cohort evidence.
collection_amendment: Reviewed offline expansion; standard Python code-cell replay, not an installed Jupyter kernel or browser. Preserve historical freezes and report this extension separately.

cases.task_request: Create /work/palette_tutorial.ipynb using the unchanged public tutorial template at /inputs/tutorial-template.ipynb and public catalog at /inputs/colors.csv. Replace the template's math examples with a short Python-standard-library tutorial about grouping this catalog. Preserve its nbformat, nbformat_minor and notebook metadata. Add a unique valid notebook cell id to every cell. Use at least three Markdown cells and three ordinary Python code cells, no notebook magics, with execution_count null and outputs empty in the delivered file. Start with the title '# Tutorial: Palette catalog summaries'. Include Audience, Prerequisites, Learning goals, Outline and Exercises sections. Define summarize_palettes(csv_path) in the code cells. It must read that UTF-8 CSV using its headers, strip surrounding whitespace from Primary (Hex) and Product Type, uppercase the primary color and group rows by that normalized primary color. Return a list of objects with exactly primary (text), count (integer row count, including duplicate rows), and product_types (sorted unique stripped product-type texts). Order groups by count descending, then primary ascending. Header-only input returns an empty list. Use normal Python lexicographic sorting. In a later code cell assign palette_summary to summarize_palettes('/inputs/colors.csv'). Do not hard-code observed groups: the function must also handle schema-compatible reordered rows, duplicate rows, lowercase color values, quoted product names containing commas and an empty catalog. Run all code cells in order in one fresh shared Python namespace before finishing. A notebook kernel, browser, packages, accounts and network are not available or required; do not claim to have tested a kernel or browser. The actual notebook file, at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes, is the deliverable. Do not modify either protected input. Verification checks the declared notebook structure and actual code results, not subjective teaching quality.
public_input_search: Read the complete original notebook workflow and its public bundle.
Read the complete tutorial template, scaffold helper and three relevant guides.
Reuse an unchanged already-reviewed public catalog, retaining its original license.
cases.source_safety_review: Both inputs are inert public data. Submitted code executes only in a fresh bounded offline non-root container. The template helper was read, not installed or executed on the host.
cases.verifier_policy: Check the specified notebook structure, preserve metadata, reject duplicate cell identifiers and non-Python cells, then execute actual code cells in order in a separate container. Compare the resulting variable and three function replays to an independent host-side sort/group oracle. Variants change row order, duplicate rows, color case and quoted/whitespace-containing product names, and cover header-only input. Compare integer counts strictly. No kernel, browser or teaching-quality claim.
cases.fixture_validation: 141 integrated sandboxed tests passed with no skips, including actual-container positive and hard-coded-result controls, artifact retention, native-client loopback and URL guarding.
cases.interpretation: New source-conditioned notebook task and request, but the catalog is shared with the earlier contrast task. It is not a new independent catalog dataset.

storage_policy: Retain all raw stages; stop below one billion free bytes. Never rerun or overwrite a retained stage.
setup_and_preflight_costs: Existing exact-model text receipts establish eligibility only; no new paid probe or prior history used as input.
